name: hybrid-coordinator
description: A shared-runtime coordinator that answers lightweight questions and delegates real filesystem or shell work to one-shot container jobs.

tools.name: delegate_job
tools.description: Queue durable container work and return immediately. Select optional workspace files to snapshot. Do not poll; completion is delivered to this conversation.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read the status, bounded result, and retained artifact manifest of a job delegated by this conversation. Never loop-poll during a turn.

tools.name: read_job_artifact
tools.description: Read a bounded portion of a retained output artifact without requiring its container to remain alive.

tools.name: import_job_artifact
tools.description: Explicitly import an output artifact into the conversation workspace. Existing files require an exact destination etag; files are never silently overwritten.
